ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR40] Requires Service Address on moving into Solutioning or Negotiation only (narrowed per IRM). Service_Address__Street__s confirmed correct compound-field proxy, answering IRM's question.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
OR( QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'United States', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Canada', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Ireland', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'France', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Belgium', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Netherlands', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Sweden', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Denmark' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ),
ISBLANK(Service_Address__Street__s) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Service Address is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter the address.
